_meta._comment: Set by wiki-setup wizard. When setup_completed=true, skills skip the 'run setup first' warning.

viewer._comment_scheme: Options: file | cursor | vscode — controls 'Open file' links in the static viewer

firecrawl._comment: Clean markdown from any URL. Get key: https://firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys

perplexity._comment: AI-powered research queries. Get key: https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api

twitter._comment: Fetch tweets/threads/search. Install bird CLI: npm install -g @steipete/bird — zero config for public tweets via FxTwitter API (no token needed). Get auth_token from browser DevTools → Application → Cookies.

brave._comment: Brave Search API — best for RAG grounding. Modes: web | news | llm-context | answers. Free key: https://api.search.brave.com

annas_archive._comment: Anna's Archive — fast ebook/paper downloads. Requires membership. https://annas-archive.org/account

playwright._comment: Headless Chromium fetch (pip install playwright && playwright install chromium). Same raw/ output shape as url/firecrawl.

ingestion._comment_max_download_bytes: Maximum response body accepted by the built-in URL ingest adapter (32 MiB).

sound._comment_allow_arbitrary: If true, hooks.sound.command runs any argv (vault config is trusted). If false, only absolute paths to executables or known players (afplay, say, aplay, …).

mcp._comment_search: Options: fts5 (BM25) | grep | chromadb (semantic) | hybrid (FTS5+Chroma RRF; requires chromadb). hybrid_rrf_k: RRF constant for hybrid only.
mcp._comment_transport: transport: stdio (default, editor MCP) | sse — HTTP POST JSON-RPC on host:port (see llm-wiki mcp --transport sse)
mcp._comment_tools_mode: full | read_only | custom — custom + empty tools_allowlist behaves as read_only
mcp._comment_hardening: Safe defaults: ingest_enabled/benchmark_tool_enabled false; allow_local_file_ingest false. Empty configure_allowlist denies mcp.*/security.*/storage.*/hooks.* and path sinks. Enable write tools after review. See skills/references/mcp-and-kg.md

knowledge_graph._comment_backend: Options: json (zero deps, vault/.kg.json) | sqlite (temporal validity, stdlib sqlite3)

memory._comment_enabled: Per-session memory files under raw/memory/ (hooks + memory CLI).
memory._comment_dir: Directory under vault for session memory markdown files.
memory._comment_max_sessions: After each memory save/log: if file count > this, delete oldest by mtime (0 = unlimited auto-prune off; use memory prune manually).

storage._comment: Vault-relative paths only (resolved under the vault root). Absolute or escaping paths are rejected.

sqlite._comment_journal: wal = best concurrent reads; delete = legacy default
sqlite._comment_sync: normal = safe with WAL, 2-3x faster writes; full = max durability
sqlite._comment_cache: Negative = KB; -8192 = 8 MB page cache; -32768 = 32 MB
sqlite._comment_busy: Milliseconds to wait on lock contention before SQLITE_BUSY

rerank_llm._comment: invoke: anthropic_api | claude_cli | codex_cli | custom_cli (set cli_argv). LLM_WIKI_BENCHMARK_LLM=1 + key or CLI. ~500 calls / full LME run.

benchmark._comment: Retrieval benchmarks (llm-wiki benchmark run lme). Peer LME: benchmark run lme --peer mem0. See benchmarks/README.md.

metrics._comment: Opt-in operational metrics. Records to storage.metrics_db (default .metrics.jsonl). Enable to track search latency, KG operations, MCP tool calls.
